 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of the setting value of thermocouple 
 and record at MRDS.
Disconnect RTD wires and isolate the wires using tape.
Remove RTD from thermowell and take it to lab.
Put the RTD into the oven.

Adjust the oven temperature to the correct value, wait 5 minutes using 
 ohmmeter check if contact change its situation.

If there is any error 
 adjust the contact and repeat step 2 until reach the correct value.

Repeat step 2 but for the other values of deg. C 
 as stated in the MRDS.
Return RTD to service by removing the ohmmeter leads from the RTD terminal .
Return the RTD back to its location.

Place a copy of 
 test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
This 
document outlines 
the checklist 
I1, which must be carried out on 
an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 10 Jan 2003, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes,
Oven 
 Temperature tester.
Ohmmeter
Work to be carried out
Steps to Prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of the setting value of thermocouple 
 and record at MRDS.
Disconnect RTD wires and isolate the wires using tape.
Remove RTD from thermowell and take it to lab.
Testing 
Procedure
Put the RTD into the oven.
Adjust the oven temperature to the correct value, wait 5 minutes using 
 ohmmeter check if contact change its situation.
If there is any error 
 adjust the contact and repeat step 2 until reach the correct value.
Repeat step 2 but for the other values of deg. C 
 as stated in the MRDS.
Return RTD to 
service
Return RTD to service by removing the ohmmeter leads from the RTD terminal .
Remove RTD from oven tester.
Return the RTD back to its location.
Connect the RTD wires.
Place a copy of 
 test result in the field maintenance file.
